message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: a medical staff (医务人员) received bribes (回扣) totaling 68,000 RMB from a medical device company via a person. This is illegal receipt of money, i.e., "受贿" (accepting bribes). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "受贿罪". The description: illegal receipt of money for using position to benefit others. So the crime is "受贿". Possibly also "行贿" is for the company, but we only charge the defendant. So single crime: 受贿.
